586.synopsis:
Vice Admiral Lezirth Dawnbringer, the Commander of Dawn Corps in the First Marines of the Space Federation. He became a war hero after leading the human race to victory with the army of alien life form known as Letix.
However, when he awakes from coldsleep, 120 years has passed?! Being re-recruited into the navy in a world far from the ideal peaceful one that he dreamt of, Lezirth is treated as an attention seeker. So eventually, he and his boss, Admiral Luise Maynard who was also in coldsleep for 120 years, gets assigned to a platoon led by a half Elcro girl.
Amongst the great forces of the Federation and Alliance, Lezirth must find his very own Kishin Dawnbringer and charge in to the battlefield!

1354.synopsis:
The life of a cyborg, programmed to protect his overprotective older brother and ordered to conceal his identity from his classmates.
Part serious, part comedy; plot deepens as it goes on.

2378.synopsis:
One is a blind girl, the embodiment of an orchid, intelligent with sophisticated grace, and the other, a young noble who loved his wealth as if it were his life.
His endless teasing, and her numerous counter-attacks,
She planned every advance with detail, and he met her with each step,
As he excitedly went about making life difficult for her, all she did was sigh at his childishness.
The uneasy-proud-young noble’s odd actions, contrasted against the calm plotting of an unfazed blind girl.
*Haih, one should never invite the attentions of a petty man…*
The two were at loggerheads from the very beginning, and to no one’s surprise, they soon saw each other as the enemy, and neither tried to understand the other’s position.
And thus it came to this,
as long as the Young Lady did not give in, then the Young Sir would not leave her in peace.
A blind girl thrice married, but to the same person every time.
Thrice wedded, thrice wedded to;
But together forever after.

3914.synopsis:
Since then, time has moved forward.
All of us have matured a little.
But despite the fact that we are all flying in different directions in order to fully stretch our wings,
we are still soaring beneath the same sky.
That is easily understood after carefully listening to each of our singing voices.
Continuation and side stories of Sayonara Piano Sonata, it consist of 5 stories:
“sonate pour deux” — narrated by Naomi
If There’s No Name on the Wing — third person narrative on a guest performer for feketerigó
Stereophonic Love — third person narrative on Yuri
The Final Interview — narrated by Naomi / Kyouko
Nobody Sleeps Tonight — narrated by Tetsurou
“Sonate pour deux” and Nobody Sleeps Tonight gives closure to the entire SPS series, several years after their high school days.

6474.synopsis:
Xuan Tian comes from a powerful clan. However, he has taken his mother’s surname and is now named Huang Tian. This is because he, his parents and his mother’s side of the family had to flee when he was still a young child. His father’s brother plotted against his father which resulted in the Xuan family giving a million miles chase.
The Huang family members were all injured, many died. He himself almost died, if it wasn’t for his grandpa who took the final blow for him. His grandpa, once a strong fighter, is now crippled. All his remaining family members dropped in fighting power due to their injuries.
Xuan Tian’s cultivation is now also limited due to his injuries as a child. Nevertheless, he entered a sword school and worked hard to gain enough power for revenge and to cure his family.
This was hopeless as his cultivation is painstakingly slow. Until one time he fell into a pond where a sword spirit entered his body, curing his injuries.

6730.synopsis:
Chen Xiao was an 18-year-old orphan, his parents used to be cutting-edge researchers but both of them died in a research accident two years ago.
And on his 18th birthday, he received a mysterious phone call from a person claiming to be his parents’ friends. The person on the call said that his parents entrusted them with the task of sending something over to their son, Chen Xiao.
Chen Xiao rushed home and was surprised to see the thing sent by his parents:
A big refrigerator, and inside it, a sleeping beauty…….
Since then, his life completely changed.

6986.synopsis:
A minus’ hand that fails every singer he put his hands on, Kang Yoon.
After being chased by loan sharks, he meets his death, losing his beloved sister and his everyday life.
However, with those 10 years earned through coincidence…
In his new life, he will walk the path to the best planner.
3rd rate or 1st rate, through his hands, they will become legends!!

7242.synopsis:
Thirty thousand years ago, the Heaven Fighting Race who called themselves “Gods” invaded Spirit Realm. Hundreds of races rose up in resistance, but ultimately suffered a crushing defeat. The human race was the first to concede, and the rest of the Hundred Races soon followed in succession.
During the subsequent ten thousand years, all of the races were ens*aved by the Heaven Fighting Race. They were cruelly treated, and lived beneath the shadow of terror.
The Heaven Fighting Race’s march of conquest did not stop there. With Spirit Realm as the starting point, they invaded other secret dimensions, and spread war to all corners of existence. After greatly exhausting their combat strength, they were finally defeated by the Hundred Races who took advantage of this opportunity. With no other choice, they fled to the starry skies outside the realm.
Thirty thousand years later, in an era where the Heaven Fighting Race has already faded to become ancient legend, an amnesiac youth possessing the Heaven Fighting Race’s bloodline is being fostered in an insignificant household. Whilst struggling to live on, he silently awaits the day of the bloodline’s awakening.

8010.synopsis:
Souma, a King of  the smallest, yet the richest country in the world, possessed the power ‘to import things’ from ‘another world’ with ‘money’. When the enemy nation invaded, he ‘import’ tanks and machine guns from another world and defeated the sword and arrow equipped enemy army.
He imported many things that broken the dimension and barriers of the worlds, making the country gradually become prosperous, which make citizens immigrated to the country one after another.
Since the small country didn’t had enough territory for the increased population to settle, since it couldn’t be helped, he expanded the country’s territory and ended up reigned as the Emperor of a Grand Empire.
associated_names: 石油王の国作り～オイルマネーで異世界無双

8266.synopsis: He has lived through war, famine, and disease. He has seen the gates of death, touched the gates of hell, but was given a chance. A chance bestowed to him by the gods, a chance at immortality. Reborn and rejected but not hopeless, he will rise above all expectations. He will take on the sword of blood, he will make all revere, for this is the path he has chosen. Nothing will block his path, be it riches, or fools, Jerks or the arrogant, let them come to meet only their demise. The path of the dao, the path of a commander. He is the Great Dao Commander. he stands above all else, for everything is one; one in him. He is the controller of the beginning and the end.

9034.synopsis: When Li Shen’s second personality acts out, her consciousness is sent to a strange place called Split Zone No.13. She is then informed that she can only return home after unraveling the truth.
associated_names: Jin Lie Qu Shi San Hao

10570.synopsis:
This is a battlefield where you kill or get killed.
Gender or social status do not matter. Only the strong survive.
From 120 billion human population, only 40 billion can stay alive. In this 40 billion, only 18 billion are reserved for the females. There is only a 6.66% survival rate for Xia Mo.
After being betrayed and killed, she gets reincarnated before the game starts. Determination burning in her heart, this time, in this second life of hers, she plans to secure a seat in the 18 billion slots.
Survival Game begins.

12106.synopsis:
When she reborn, she finally understood; men can never be relied on.
That being the case, she can only rely on herself to win, that splendid brilliance she yearned for, in this lifetime.
To my scheming stepmother and ruthless sister, I will destroy all your backings, pull off your wings, and step on your arrogance! As for grandmother whom speaks kindly but has a snake-like heart, and a father who is hypocritical and exploits advantages; I will tear off your pretense and cut off your hope! Let’s see how you can still scheme against me!
Witness her splendid fight against her stepmother, punish s*um men, and create havoc in the imperial court, as she soars with the wind and rises above the water!
But as for that man who still stands! How dare he play with my heart?
associated_names: Phoenix Reborn: the Prime Minister’s Scheming Daughter

13898.synopsis:
Our protagonist Caam is a man from Earth that was reincarnated into this world as a demon. In order to survive, he spared no effort in avoiding the sparks of battle and without noticing it, he became strong himself.
Then, one day a demon that is stronger than himself suddenly appeared in front of his eyes. The demon said 「You seem quite strong. Don’t you think someone that strong should become a Demon Lord?」. He tried to negotiate but he had no right to refuse.
associated_names: Maou ni nattara Ryouchi ga Mujintou datta
魔王になったら領地が無人島だった

15690.synopsis:
A master assassin transmigrates into an interstellar era.
Other players were responsible for competing in the e-sports arena, while he was responsible for stringing up and beating up the other players.
His sword was hidden during the peak of day, and he was a gentleman who arrived in a flash of light;
 As a vanguard of the eternal night, he was the variable between life and death in the world.
“As you know, the Star League’s difficulty levels are arranged in this way:
Paradise < Simple < Normal < Difficult < Nightmare < Hell < [Tyron Odin]”

16202.synopsis: I have a non-blood related older brother. When we were young, I thought he was very lovable and I wanted to protect him. As we grew up, it all went wrong. He turned into a ridiculous bastard.

17482.synopsis:
After the nth time of failing a marriage meeting, Xiang Han got himself a job: good treatment, high salary, free world traveling with food provided, house provided and even a ‘lover provided’?!
At first, he thought, apart from having to travel into the body of a s*um cannon fodder, a scheming fake white lotus, everything else was okay. It was only later he realized that saving the target was also a problem. His imagination was neverending, even eating a cup of ramen was seen as a way to rouse his (the target’s) interest!
Xiang Han: This target is a no-go.
Certain Target: Very good, you’ve already managed to rouse my interest. 
Xiang Han: Go outside and make a left turn to the optometrist, go get your eyes healed! Additionally, this “lover provided” isn’t necessary.
A Certain Target: This is certainly necessary!
associated_names: 目标总以为我喜欢他[快穿]

17738.synopsis:
Tsukagi Saki’s life had never been of interest to her.
However, one night as she walked the path that lay on the boundary between the forest and the city, she met an encounter that would irrevocably change the course of her life.
“Would you like to marry me?”
As dim street lights flickered weakly, a pure white wolf faced the young girl, overlooked by the brilliance of the new moon. It was an odd request from a character no one would ever expect, and yet nothing felt more right to Saki. So she accepted.
And on that cold winter night, with the union of these two solitary entities, a fundamental shift took place as ‘legends’ began to overflow into the world as they knew it.
This, was where everything began. The story of a girl, a wolf, and their struggle as their worlds begin to crumble.
Winner of the 4th Media Factory Rookie Novel Award.
associated_names: Kono Hiroi Sekai ni Futari Bocchi
この広い世界にふたりぼっち

18250.synopsis: A short story between a rich young man and a poor prostitute.

18762.synopsis: There was an old story that circulated for quite a long time, a story that happened in the City of Maretilin, about two necromancers and a hero who conquered them, a wandering magician named Leder. After the story, though no such record supported it, there really was a magician named Leder who passed the magicians’ tests. All the magician organizations on the grand land, from the Necromancers’ Union in the south to the Tower of The Wise in the north, agreed that Leder was the most powerful magician in history. They called him “The Grand Wise.”

20042.synopsis: Will do anything for the right amount! Has someone refused to pay? Do you want people beaten up? Do you suspect that your wife, or husband is cheating on you? The Federation Marshal with the privilege of ‘Unconditional Innocence’ Allen Strauss is by your side!

21834.synopsis: Zhou Yu, a reclusive otaku who did not like to go out of his house, was one day forced out of his house by a series of unexpected events.

22346.synopsis: One day, the main character, Kiranuma Shinji helped a boy and died. When he woke up, the so called God reincarnated him to a different world. Then, Shinji chose race and occupation. Shinji’s chosen race is vampire. Occupation is labyrinth creator! Will Shinji be able to properly live in the different world!?
associated_names: isekai de meikyu souzou-sha《Dungeon Master》o yattemasu！
異世界で迷宮創造者《ダンジョンマスター》をやってます！

23882.synopsis:
I, Aristides Castro G Morris Brooklyn Washington Napoleon George I, doth proclaim myself as the sovereign of this realm. Our untimely demise hath been the consequence of preserving our people from impending doom. To reward our noble deeds, the gracious goddess hath bestowed upon us the gift of rebirth. Yet, alas! Why have we been transformed into a maiden, and a princess of dragons, no less?!
This extraordinary story follows a man haunted by Eight-Grade Syndrome, now reborn as the dragons’ princess. However, his chuunibyou tendencies come with a price—a curse cast upon him by a vexed goddess. Every time his symptoms flare up, lightning strikes, an electrifying consequence of his behavior.
Prepare for a captivating journey as this chuunibyou princess navigates the realms of dragons, adventure, and self-discovery. With lightning crackling at every turn, our protagonist must embrace their newfound identity, face formidable challenges, and uncover the secrets that lie within this enchanting world. In this tale of curses and resilience, embark on an enthralling adventure where destiny and the whims of the divine intertwine.
associated_names: I will make a Harem even if I reincarnated as a Dragon Lo*i
就算穿越成龙族萝莉吾也要开后宫

25418.synopsis:
I’m an imperial uncle; his imperial majesty’s uncle.
Once, someone with nothing better to do took a comprehensive survey of the current dynasty, and summed up the imperial court’s three great cancers.
Wang Qin leads in corruption; the treasury is never full.
Yun Tang favours a few, forming cabals; leading to corruption in our politics.
Prince Huai plays with power, and serves as the head of a hundred poisons — thus causing instability to the throne.
When they talk about the most venomous of vipers, the wicked one who plays with power, the biggest cancer of them all, they’re talking about me: this insignificant prince, Prince Huai, Chengjun.
I can only say that I feel rather hapless in the face of these theories.
In truth, I have been ever dutiful, ever devoted, devoid of intention to monopolise power, and possess even less of a heart to covet the throne. In the entire imperial court, I dare say there is no loyal subject more loyal than I.
But, most tragically, in all the realm, the matter of me being a loyal subject is something that not many would believe.

28490.synopsis:
Zhang Dianyu becomes the warden in a prison construction game.
Since the prison started receiving a variety of peculiar transferred inmates, his daily prison reports have turned into this:
– Hydra inmates attempting to infiltrate Zone D guards to incite a small-scale riot—spent a fortune to stop it.
–  A certain mentally unstable villain trying to blow up the prison walls to escape—spent a fortune to stop it.
–  A certain escape expert attempting to dig a tunnel to escape—spent a fortune to stop it.
–  Financial status: Deficit!!!
Zhang Dianyu: There seems to be something wrong with this game?
Undercover superheroes: …This prison is wrong in every way!
Inmates: The new guys are all talented… I just want to focus on reforming myself, applying for sentence reduction and parole, and staying far away from them.
Zhang Dianyu: For some reason, the inmates’ work enthusiasm has skyrocketed, but the prison seems to be getting poorer?
To reduce the escape rate and build a harmonious and civilized prison, Zhang Dianyu decides to don a disguise and personally teach the escaping inmates a lesson.
The only problem is that abandoning the disguise requires faking his death.
Zhang Dianyu thinks it’s not a big deal.
Getting exposed is impossible.
Absolutely impossible in this lifetime.
Later: “………………”

29514.synopsis:
When Su Yuanyuan was playing with her baby, she suddenly felt a little sleepy and went back to sleep in the bedroom. Who knew that after waking up, her world would be turned upside down.
Her most beloved husband looked at her with cold, unfamiliar eyes, “I urge you to stop pretending to be pitiful, return her back to me.” Su Yuanyuan: Return what??? Her closest family members keep a safe distance from her: “Sorry, stop bothering us.”
Su Yuanyuan: Dad, Mom, Big Brother, what are you guys doing? ? ? The twin babies she gave birth to in October had eyes red with a grievance: “Why can other children live with their mother, but my little brother and I can’t.”
Su Yuanyuan: My baby … Later, Su Yuanyuan learned that her body was taken over by some other unfamiliar woman for five full years. In these five years, her family had missed her.
A/N: Seen too many transmigrating white moonlight supporting female lead, occasionally it’s not too bad to have an original white moonlight female lead!
associated_names: 在书里我是最惨的白月光女配

32330.synopsis:
Fia, who was aiming to be a knight as the daughter of a knight, remembers her previous life as a “great saint” when she was on the verge of dying.
 . . . Huh?
 Saints are a revered profession because they’re so weakened and on the verge of extinction, right? 
The only saintly power I use is the ‘lost magic’ that has become a fairy tale.
Come to think of it, in my previous life, the Demon Lord’s right hand man threatened to kill me if I was reincarnated as a saint.
If I use this kind of power, they’ll know that I am a saint and will probably kill me in one fell swoop.
. . . so I’ll become a knight as per my original intentions! I will live quietly!　
Nah, I thought about it, but I’ll use the power I have because it’s too useful . . .
associated_names: A Tale of the Great Saint
A Tale of the Secret Saint (LN)
Tensei Shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo dearu Koto wo Hitakakusu
The Reincarnated Great Saint Hides That She's a Saint
転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す

32842.synopsis:
《Live Action mu*der Mystery》Case File:
A live script acting, deductive reasoning game.
Poor performances result in death.
–
If you draw the Deceased Card, please follow the script accordingly and die;
If you draw the mu*derer Card, you might be the real mu*derer, please ensure that you conceal your identity.
Detective, please try your best to guide the players and find the real mu*derer, or else you will be met with the death penalty.
–
Have you drawn the mu*derer Card this day?
——–【System Reminder 】———
Please obey the character design set by the script during enactment, by no means OOC;
Inferences should be made with the script settings as the norm, by no means diverge your thoughts;
The system has the final right to interpretation, have a happy game!
—————-
Gong + Shou: “A pair of As.”
System: “Can’t afford it.”

33354.synopsis:
The first time Cheng Yao met Qian Heng, she couldn’t believe that this tall, handsome man with an air of elegance was the same “cancer of the industry” everyone warned her about.
His deep, captivating eyes made it even harder to believe.
Cheng Yao was skeptical—how could someone who looked this good be a cancer?
Until reality hit her hard—
She secretly observed Qian Heng’s every move, hoping to learn from him.
Her boss, expressionless and blunt as ever, remarked, “Stop staring. You’ve been watching me for days. If you have time to admire me, why not spend it reviewing case files?”
“……” Dude, you’re overthinking this.
When she asked for a raise—
Qian Heng gave no direct response. But that evening, for the first time, he showed up at a company gathering and personally dedicated a song to her—”When Dreams Are Shattered.”
—
[Mini Theater] 
Cheng Yao had too much to drink at the annual party. She ran up to the stage, grabbed the microphone, and shouted:
“What’s so great about Qian Heng? Just because he’s a partner?! One day, when I make it big, he’ll have to listen to me! From then on, I’ll be the one calling the shots! I, Cheng Yao, will make sure he knows what it means when I say— Your! Turn! Has! Come!”
That day, no one could forget the terrifying expression on Qian Heng’s face from the audience…
But what they didn’t know was—
The next day, Cheng Yao was cornered against a wall by Qian Heng.
With a blank expression, he said, “Don’t I already listen to you at home? In private, you call the shots. But at work? No. You still have to listen to me.”
“…”

35914.synopsis:
Ling Xinyue’s fiance is a big jerk! Seducing her adopted sister, scheming her property…  
So she slept with a stranger in a fit of pique!
A few months later, while she’s pregnant, gossip of Mu’s secret fiancee had spread everywhere. 
Misfortunes never come singly. Her father was drugged and sent to the hospital. Everything in her family was about to be taken away by the bit*h couple. 
In desperation, she had to be cheeky and ask Mu for help… but she was forced to stay with Mu by the time the dust settled.
“Just remember, you initiated this…  For you, it may be over. For me, it’s not!” 
“Fine! The child belongs to you and we can call it even!” She resisted furiously. 
“But then, what about the marriage contract you owe me?” Mu said with a smile.
associated_names: 天价二婚：慕少宠妻如命

39754.synopsis:
I, the immortal witch Milia, extended a helping hand to Lily, a poor girl bullied by her stepfamily.
I’ll clean Lily up and give her a beautiful then take her to the ball where a Prince is looking for his Princess!
She’ll catch the Prince’s heart! She’ll become the Queen! It’ll all happen in the blink of an eye!
All her hard work and the hardships she’s faced so far will be rewarded and she should become the happiest person in the country…
Hello, Lily? Why are you holding my hand and blushing????
Eh…?! You like girls, Lily!?
“Ms. Wiiiitttch! Please accept my loooooovveee…!!!”
“Awawawa… why is this happening?!”
It’s a Carnivorous Yuri Cinderella and a Naive Witch. A unique Cinderella Story.
associated_names: Cinderella wa Ouji-sama yori, Mahou wo Kake ni Kita Majo ga Suki na you desu. Komakai Koto wa Dou demo Ii node, Onna Doushi de Shiawase ni Narimashou.
シンデレラは王子様より、魔法をかけにきた魔女が好きなようです。細かいことはどうでもいいので、女同士で幸せになりましょう。

40522.synopsis:
Chosen by the divine sword as a “natural gift”–this guy is a warrior and invincible!
Licht is the abominable son of a prestigious noble family. The guy, despised as incompetent by those around him, is the one with the “natural talent” to pull out the legendary divine sword! With his invincible talent and undefeated swordsmanship – a guy who boasts infinite strength, he takes on the Royal Academy, where vicious conspiracies are swirling around him!

42314.synopsis:
Bianca de Blanchefort. 
The wife of Zachary de Arno, thrown out of Arno family after his death due to her self-indulgent, frivolous, and immoral behavior. She had nowhere to go, the Blanchefort family having already fallen to ruin, and was more or less kicked to a convent out in the border. A woman who ultimately met her end on a cold stone floor. 
A villainess with no honor.
That was Bianca’s life before she went back in time. 
***
“Is this truly reality? Did I really travel back to the past?”
This was neither a dream nor a hallucination. This feeling of hunger, fatigue, the vivid sense of everything around her…
This was all real. 
If this was indeed reality… If God truly gave her one more precious chance…!  
‘I’m going to carry out a business. A marriage is a business in the end. Zachary’s child will be the perfect source of financial support. I’m sure my dowry will remain safe too. I won’t have to lose the Blanchefort or Arno territories to that damned viscount either.’
Then whether it be through seduction or persuasion, she needed to give birth to her husband, Zachary’s child. 
“How much was my dowry exactly?”
“400 calves, 900 pigs, 100 units of silverware, 300 rolls of silk, 2 crates of jewels, and a portion of a territory… Equivalent to a two-year budget for the Arno county.”
“Don’t you think you should compensate for that?”

43850.synopsis:
I possessed an extra who died as soon as the original work started.
I was the hero’s incompetent guide.
Only until I die, will the hero meet his new guide, the heroine.
To safely stray from the original work,
I pretended to be dead after consuming a toxic flower that throws you into a coma, but-
“My guide isn’t breathing anymore.”
……?
“Who the hell can stop me?”
The hero awakened and went berserk?
You awakened after thinking I died?
You can’t possibly awaken like this….!
***
“You’re leaving me?”
Bliss scoffed at Shana’s resignation letter.
“Is this a new joke?”
“No. You don’t need a guide anymore so I…….”
“Shana.”
Bliss called her in a soft but determined voice.
“You can make fun of me, you can deceive me like a fool, or you can play with me as much as you want.
So don’t even joke about trying to leave me.”
Bliss whispered to Shana with a beautiful smile that looked like a painting.
“I just can’t let that slide.”
associated_names: I Woke Up To Find Myself Dead
You Awakened while I Was Dead
ปลุกพลังได้เพราะฉันตายเหรอคะ
私が死んで覚醒しちゃうなんて

46410.synopsis: During my entire lifetime, I’ve never encountered someone who yearned for something to such a degree, that even after being bruised all over, and drained of life, he still reached out his hand in order to capture that thing firmly.

46666.synopsis:
She is an ancient profound iron ladle from the cultivation realm. Since she has become a spirit, her only obsession is cultivating a fragrant and soft female body. 
A sky thunder smashed her into a wealthy family novel, and she became a true missy who had been wronged in life. 
The real missy is the opposite of the fake. She loves vanity and lacks IQ. She is married to the half-paralyzed young uncle of the hero. She focuses on destroying the relationship between the heroine and the hero and ends up miserably. 
Faced with the plot of a dog’s blood novel, she has only one thought: Great. She can finally be a cute and charming girl.
Later, she shook ten pounds of iron wok in one hand and kicked a big pe*vert to cry and whimpers. 
Everyone: Do you have any misunderstandings about the words “cute and charming”? 
Tang Qiaoqiao has good cooking skills. She cooks on one show and also on the next show. While filming, she also works part-time as a chef in the crew. She has become popular. 
Her black fans turned to love her and only wished to eat her food. Her co-actor would rather freeload her meal. A director strongly invited her to act because she cured his stomach disease… 
A certain president who wants to monopolize her: Enough. She only cooks for me!
*
Shen Yue was paralyzed after a car accident. His temperament changed drastically, and his life seemed to fall into the boundless darkness. 
At this time, she was the only light in his life. Not only she healed his legs, captured his stomach, but also occupied his heart. 
What, if his legs are cured, they will get divorced? 
Don’t even think about it!
associated_names: Real daughters rely on food to counterattack the entertainment industry
Zhēn qiānjīn kào měishí nì xí yúlè quān
真千金靠美食逆袭娱乐圈

47690.synopsis:
“Hi, wanna listen to a song?”
A meeting between a man and a woman that happened by chance.
associated_names: I Accidentally Connected My Bluetooth to Someone Else's Phone in the Subway
当我在地铁上误连别人的手机蓝牙后

48202.synopsis:
One day, a shocking piece of news arrives in the city of wizards. The entire family of wizard Solar Sing Eira has died—
and so, he is to become the next Lord Solar.
But the hometown he returns to in a hurry feels completely unfamiliar. He barely manages to hold the funeral with some shady retainers, then faints from sheer stress and exhaustion. When he opens his eyes again…
Hello, Master! Nice to meet you! ^o^
I’m your adorable Spirit GM here to assist with your dream-filled and I’m so excited to be working with you! Yahoo! Before we begin, would you like to name me? ☞ Enter Name ______
A pebble-like spirit just called me “Master”…?
Level-up quests, and even notification windows that look exactly like a UI from my previous life’s games.
Wait… why does this feel like modern gaming?
Reminded of the games he used to love, he decides to take on the quests—
and take a look around his territory while he’s at it. But that territory…
[Days until the fall of the Solar Territory: D-234] 
“234 days until collapse…?”
Well. First things first—let’s get the succession ceremony over with. Somehow… we’ll manage.

49226.synopsis:
The sixth desk on the seating chart summaries the youth between you and I.
Ultimately, he did not wait for the summer cicadas to sing.
And he did not wait for my words—
“I like you.”

49738.synopsis:
Self-made billionaire Lu Feng, 35 and single, is transported into the body of someone who has the same name but is living in 1990! 54602.synopsis:
Fusang is a little fox, a wild little fox without a father, mother, or anyone to look after him.
He once brought away a wrinkled infant when he was young.
This wrinkly infant grew into a handsome young man later in life.
Fusang craved his tenderness and stayed by his side day after day, even getting tricked into marrying him.
Fusang awoke the day after the wedding with reddish eyes and a pouting mouth.
What gentleman, it was all a lie! Bamboo Spirit was right, men can’t be trusted!
The little fox angrily packed his little bundle and wanted to return to his fox cave, but he was stopped at the entryway by someone.
“SangSang, you said yesterday that you want to stay with me for the rest of your life,” the newlywed husband remarked, holding back the brilliance in those gorgeous eyes.

58698.synopsis:
“…… Please allow me to receive the delegation alongside you, Your Majesty.”
“No. There isn’t anyone that doesn’t know that I don’t have a shred of feelings for you anyways, so is there a need to put on an act?”
The nobles covered their mouths with fans at the sight of the Empress being openly embarrassed by the Emperor but didn’t retract their gazes.
Along with the fed-up Edmund’s unkind treatment, the courage that was squeezed out disappeared instantly, and Sotis bowed her head without saying anything.
Sotis loved Edmund.
But Edmund hated Sotis.
“I have no intention of letting you go today.”
“I’ve never asked you to let go of me. It’s alright if you make a mess, so hurry…”
The Emperor, who’d made the Empress become an object of gossip for the nobles, sought his mistress’ embrace. Sotis felt miserable whenever she saw Edmund whispering affectionately to another woman.
‘Will everyone be happy if I disappear? Would it be alright if I disappeared? It’s just, if only I could disappear.’
***
Within the bedroom where the Empress slept quietly without waking, only a mage saw her wounded soul. 
As Sotis sat by the window, she seemed shy and embarrassed, while combing her long hair with a faint smile.  
“Even if you don’t lift a finger, there will definitely be someone that likes Your Majesty just the way you are.”
Although it was her first meeting that mage, the mage responded to her innermost thoughts as though he knew about everything. 
“I’ll find a way. Just like how you saved me, I will also ensure that both of your feet will touch the ground once again.”
[……If you say that, it sounds as though such a day would definitely arrive.]
The mage turned his back on the Empress, who was lying on the bed beautifully and whispered to the soul by the window every day, eventually managing to awaken Sotis’ physical body…
“Tomorrow morning, we will declare our divorce. The reason for the divorce is your body’s poor condition, your soul’s instability, and your inability to carry on the family line.” 
Through a single mage’s utmost dedication, Empress Sotis was able to regain her body, but what she was faced with was the Emperor’s notice of divorce.

Pei Jiu picked up a girl by the riverside. He settled her on the mountain, and planned to send her back once she recovered. This delicate girl was a useless crybaby, so Pei Jiu had to be a nice person. He cooked her food and washed her clothes. He let the troublesome girl ride on his shoulders so she could pick fruits. During winter, he would warm up the bed for her. One day, she hugged Pei Jiu’s arm with a smile. “Big Brother Pei, you’re really an honest and a good man. I will marry you and give birth to your babies!”
Pei Jiu eyed her critically and scathingly enumerated her shortcomings. She was ignorant and spoiled. She only knew how to pester and flirt with people all day long. Give birth to babies? Go ahead, give birth to caterpillars.
The delicate girl bawled so hard that she passed out. The next day, Pei Jiu returned to his mansion and told his servants to prepare for his wedding ceremony. When he returned to the mountain in the evening, Pei Jiu opened the door as usual, but he found that the cheeky girl had disappeared. He searched the whole mountain for her to no avail. No one would act like a spoiled brat in front of him anymore. What a headache.

77642.synopsis: The Demon King’s descent into reality. At the same time, the rankers of the virtual reality game  will exert their power in the real world. …… The world is falling apart in a fierce battle. The number one ranked player, Choi Kang-ho, fights alone until the end and closes his eyes. “This time, I will defeat the Demon King.” A dreamlike return to the past has occurred, and from now on, a player’s dominance over the regressing players begins!

85834.synopsis:
Ning Qiuqiu transmigrated into a book, becoming the role of the spoiled rich young lady who grew up with the male protagonist and constantly interferes with the romance between the main characters.
Ning Qiuqiu declared, “Who needs the male lead? I want the male lead’s brother.”
Zhan Qingyue became a vegetative patient due to an unexpected accident. He lay in bed for two years. When he woke up, he had an additional wife…
associated_names: 嫁给男主的植物人哥哥

86346.synopsis:
The immensely popular VRMMORPG [Crest Online], commonly known as [Creon], is an action game where players use the crest they selected during character creation as a weapon to battle various formidable foes.
One day, I, who was ranked world number one in Creon, was suddenly reincarnated 1000 years into the future of the game world.
Reborn as the second son of the Marquis Sylphid family, Zeros, I was given the so-called ‘outlier gift’ [Crest of Nothing], which everyone dismisses as ‘useless.’
Disappointment from my family and mockery from my older brother were my daily reality. Yet, with the memories and knowledge from my previous life, I alone knew the truth: that this [Crest of Nothing] was, in fact, the ‘strongest gift’ capable of mastering all skills.
“It’s decided then. I’m going to aim to be the world’s strongest once again in this world!”
Using my game knowledge and the [Crest of Nothing], I rapidly gained strength. Eventually, having surpassed even my former self, I became an unstoppable force in this world—
associated_names: Reincarnated 1,000 Years After the Game’s World, I Use the Strongest Gift, the ‘Crest of Nothingness,’ and My Knowledge of the Original Story to Dominate
ゲーム世界の１０００年後に転生した俺は、最強ギフト【無の紋章】と原作知識で無双する
外れギフト【無の紋章】で世界最強に　～元世界ランク１位の転生先は、１０００年後のゲーム世界でした。えっ？　スキルを無限に使えるのは俺だけなんですか？～

87370.synopsis:
Upon waking up, Ren Jia-shi found himself having turned into the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng. Born motherless and raised by Emperor Kangxi himself, who personally educated him, Ren Jia-shi was well-versed in classical literature and history, and skilled in archery and horsemanship. He had served as a substitute for imperial sacrifices and acted as regent for the state. However, he was deposed twice and eventually confined until his death.
Ren Jia-shi: …
— Ding! Congratulations, host, on successfully binding the National Prosperity Technology System. Your advanced assistant 007 is here to serve you.
— Ding! Please recite all the Four Books and Five Classics to receive a hybrid rice cultivation plan.
— Ding! Please master five foreign languages to receive a cement production formula.
— Ding! Please complete eighty-eight volumes of mathematics exam questions to receive a design blueprint for the Yellow River Reservoir.
Ren Jia-shi: Besides working hard, what else can I do?
Years later, not only was Ren Jia-shi never deposed, but he also became a renowned scientist, military strategist, thinker, educator, and received numerous honors:
#The Crown Prince with the Most Unshakable Status in History#
#The Crown Prince with the Most Unconventional Career in History#
#The Crown Prince with the Broadest Range of Expertise in History#
#The Crown Prince with the Most Side Jobs in History#

89418.synopsis: Because of his foolish way of living, Momota lost both his home and family. Just when he was about to give up on life, a police officer passing by by chance stopped him. Irritated by the officer’s strict sense of justice, Momota throws an absurd demand at the officer Hamauzu: “Sleep with me.” However, Hamauzu, risking everything, saves Momota. From that moment on, Momota vows to live for him… A single-minded love begins to change everything.

90698.synopsis:
Everyone has that one boss they’d love to knock down to a peg. But usually, you just… can’t.
“How unfortunate, Officer Amboise.”
Especially if your boss is none other than Grand Duke Curtis Shan Berk, second in line to the throne and a renowned war hero. 
Chloe Amboise faced that daily reality and shame, but a golden opportunity arose.
The King, seeking to curb the Grand Duke’s growing power, ordered him to marry a foreign noble.
“Chloe Amboise and I have started dating recently.”
“M-me?”
In the rush of the moment, Grand Duke Berk lied and pointed out Chloe—a minor aide—as his lover.
“…It’s true. His Grace proposed to me not long ago.”
Chloe matched the Grand Duke’s words instantly. Of course, she had her hidden agenda. 
Just like that, and ignoring each other’s true intentions, Chloe and Grand Duke Curtis suddenly found themselves parading as the kingdom’s newest power couple.
“Thanks. I’ll give you whatever you ask.”
‘Yes!’ Chloe Amboise’s face beamed to the point her eyes became two crescent moons.
“Then first—”
“….”
“Get on your knees, Your Grace.”
‘You don’t want to? Do you hate it? If you don’t like it, then just get married.’
The kingdom’s most handsome man’s face crumpled upon those two options.
She felt like tearing up in excitement.

91978.synopsis:
I had been a ghost for ten years.
A streamer found my cherished photo and launched a “Searching for Ji Chuan” campaign across the entire internet.
When I saw him again, he was already about to get married.
I wished I could just disappear…
Yet, after I truly disappeared, he lived out his life in solitude.
In his final moments, he still held onto that half of the photo.
associated_names: 我死后的第十年，他才回来

92234.synopsis:
The world of toys begins when night falls.
Larien, a ballerina doll, had long been secretly in love with Jayden, a nutcracker doll.
Heartbroken by his aloofness towards everyone, she eagerly counted the days
until she could confess her feelings as the ‘Queen of the Festival’.
A week before the festival, she hears unexpected news.
“Hey, have you heard the rumor?”
“What rumor?”
“They say a toy repairman is coming on the day of the festival.
If that’s true, Jayden might be able to live with normal feet.”
As the dolls’ interest in Jayden soars,
and Larien witnesses attempts to seduce him, she grows increasingly anxious.
“You know, physical intimacy leads to emotional intimacy. Jayden won’t be any different.”
As she tried to hide her impatience, her friend’s words struck her.
Physical intimacy leads to emotional intimacy?
Since she didn’t have any better ideas, couldn’t this be a possible approach?
Larien comes up with an embarrassing yet alluring plan to seduce him.

92490.synopsis:
Hong Heeju is a sign language interpreter who has become mute due to severe depression.
For three years of their arranged marriage, she and her husband never exchanged a single conversation.
One day, her life takes a harrowing turn when she’s taken hostage.
‘Don’t hang up! This isn’t a phishing call…!’
However, her husband, who was even worse than a stranger, coldly disconnected the call.
– “Call me when a body is found.”
***
You $%#£! He’s such a jerk!
Overwhelmed with anger, Heeju decides to threaten her husband anonymously.
The problem is that he was a well-known spokesperson for the Blue House.
– “Can’t you send threats on time?”
  “That…”
– “Here I’m anxiously waiting for my blackmailer’s call.”
  “What do you…”
– “Are you playing around with someone else besides me?”
  “…?”
Wait, is this the same sociopath husband I knew?

94794.synopsis:
Mino leads a dull and uneventful life, but his s*xual preferences are anything but ordinary. On a chilly winter evening, while heading home from work, he picks up an abandoned kitten and rushes it to a nearby veterinary clinic for urgent care.
He keeps in touch with the veterinarian, Dohun, who agrees to look after the cat temporarily. Mino finds himself reminded of a senior from his past, a man whose face he can’t forget and whose memory has left a deep impression on him. Eventually, Mino starts getting treatment from Dohun for an accidental knee injury…

95306.synopsis:
After devoting his life to becoming a munchkin, Lee Bum-seok’s lifespan was nearing its end, so he cast a reincarnation spell to escape the grim reapers. It was fine that he regained his memories from his past life after being reborn, but he was reborn as the opposite sex!?
An adventure tale of a man(?) reborn individual walking the path of a nun knight in a medieval fantasy world setting.

95562.synopsis:
A frustratingly good-natured, yet ultimately a cancerous lump of a protagonist? 
What’s that supposed to mean?

96074.synopsis:
Finding a decent male lead is harder than it looks. Why are they all so obsessed, so possessive, so utterly insane? At first, Eulia had been swayed by their appearances, but in the end, it always came down to personality. Always.
[Stop Reading] 
[Are you sure you want to drop this story?] 
Let’s go.  Fifth story’s a bust too. Next, onto the sixth.
Eulia made up her mind and tapped the back of her bookmark twice. It glowed brightly.
[The Male Leads I Abandoned] 
[Start from the beginning?] 
The bookmark vibrated.  It seemed she was entering the story.
[Male Lead: Callias Xanderwick] 
[Male Lead: Hill] 
[Male Lead: Sihak Winterhell] 
[Male Lead: Mortert] 
[Male Lead: Aktion Lahes Khan Egelperium] 
‘They’re all the same.’
The names of the male leads she had met flickered before her eyes.  Some were fleeting encounters, others long-term relationships, but regardless of the time spent, she remembered them all vividly.
‘How… how did this happen?’
Without a moment to think, Eulia’s vision flashed white.
***
Five novels. Five male leads. Having passed through all of their stories, she had arrived at the sixth novel, ‘The Male Leads I Abandoned’.  How was she supposed to deal with those five lunatics?
‘What do I do now? Am I trapped?’
Unable to even drop this unknown novel?  Everything felt hopeless.
But every story has a beginning, middle, and end. And the endings of romance fantasy novels were always the same.  The male and female leads unite, the story concludes, the novel ends.
‘If ‘The Male Leads I Abandoned’ reaches its happy ending…’
Wouldn’t the system governing this world also shut down?  If so, she had no choice.
‘Fine. I’ll play this little game of love!’

99146.synopsis:
I possessed a character in the R-rated grimdark romantasy novel ‘Master of the Cage’.
And my role? As the ultimate evil mastermind’s idiotic wife–a woman fated to die at the hands of the male protagonist who kills her husband.
I couldn’t die like that. Absolutely not. My only chance was to stop the evil mastermind’s descent into villainy.  
“This is for me? Then what will you eat, my dear? Should I buy you some chocolate instead?”
This bastard. He really treats me like I’m a five-year-old.
Well, that works fine. I’d play along, pretending to be the clueless idiot while secretly saving the mastermind’s family from certain doom.  
Like ‘accidentally’ spilling poisoned drinks and crying.
Or pretending to trip and running into bushes where assassins are hiding.
Or spilling water where explosives are hidden.
Each time, people dismissed it with a shrug. “Oh well, she’s just an idiot. She didn’t know any better.”
Except for one person.
/////
Cerden smiled softly as he cupped my cheek.
Drawing close enough to kiss, he murmured in a low, lazy voice.
“Why don’t you drop the act already?”
“Uwaaah? S-scary. I hate you, big brother!”
I brought out my secret weapon—childish speech.
But Cerden wasn’t buying it.  
“Quit the pretence. Before I really get angry.”  
His eyes flashed coldly.
I just wanted to survive.
But I ended up being mistaken as the real evil mastermind.
associated_names: I Became The Evil Mastermind's Idiot Wife
This is a Trap for You

99402.synopsis:
“Don’t make contracts carelessly. If a suspicious stranger appears, disguised with an innocent appearance making dubious offers, reject them immediately. Otherwise, you might fall into another world with your boyfriend whom you’ve only known for a short while! Even if you could tolerate that much, what if your randomly assigned role is a terminally ill patient with a tr*sh body? What if you have to complete a quest to prevent the world’s destruction with that body? And what if your partner who came with you loses his memories and starts acting like the real Northern Duke? That’s completely ruined…”
Jahyun, who was the strongest hunter in his world, wakes up with a sickly body in a snow-covered duke’s mansion.
“Shouldn’t we have a private conversation… brother?”
“My younger brother… seems to be confusing dreams and reality since he just woke up.”
The Duke before him is definitely his boyfriend from before, but something about his attitude seems strange. The overprotectiveness begins with a sharp and cold tone. “Brother, wait…” No, why is he acting like this?
“Raijin. You were supposed to be an obedient younger brother.”
Jahyun feels bewildered by his brother who seems to have no memory of their world or their relationship, treating him merely as a terminally ill younger brother. “But brother, you liked me too.”
Because that’s the kind of relationship we had.
The Top: Ludwig El Izatrix (Kwon Kyung-woo) The Duke of Izatrix. 32 years old. Black hair, black eyes, a handsome man with a cold and gloomy appearance.
Originally the CEO of a global corporation called DOHO in his original world, he became the Duke of Northern Izatrix Duchy in this world. He came to this world with Kwon Ja-hyun to complete a quest together, but for some unknown reason, he lost part of his memories and now believes he was originally the Duke.
The Bottom: Raijin El Izatrix (Kwon Ja-hyun) 23 years old. Black hair, black eyes, a handsome man with a cool appearance.
Despite his cool handsome appearance, he’s actually playful and familiar with modern subculture. In his original world, he was the Guild Master of DOHO Guild and the world’s most famous and strongest hunter. However, in this world, he’s struggling as the Duke’s sickly, terminally ill younger brother.
When to Read This: When you want to read a romantic fantasy story set against a snowy backdrop, featuring a top who has lost his memories and becomes the Northern Duke, unconsciously becoming obsessive and possessive while unable to hide his kindness, together with a sickly but sweet bottom who must resolve their situation.

100682.synopsis:
Once, Charlotte and Leo had shared a deep bond as lovers, but their relationship was severed by Charlotte’s betrayal. Years passed, Leo returned from the war, now blind, and under the king’s orders, he is now bound to marry Charlotte.
“To see me in this condition must stir old emotions within you.”
As the silence stretched, Leo broke it with a tone laced with sarcasm.
His words seemed not only aimed at Charlotte but also at himself, and the bitterness in his voice left Charlotte no choice but to force a response.
“..It’s been a while.”
She wanted to call him Leo, but the word was lodged in her throat, too painful to utter.
Charlotte buried her trembling lips in her hands, trying to stifle the emotions that threatened to overwhelm her.
As their unstable marriage continues, Leo begins to uncover the hidden truths that Charlotte has long kept concealed.

103754.synopsis:
The greatest mistake young hero Bi Qiuhan ever made was getting entangled with Sheng Xiang, the prime minister’s son, and taking him along on his journey through the jianghu.
A frail nobleman, who couldn’t even leave home without bringing his pet, was hardly suited for such tumultuous times. The jianghu was rife with conflicts and danger—traveling with Sheng Xiang was bound to bring disaster, not fortune.
Yet, no matter how hard Bi Qiuhan tried, he couldn’t shake him off or abandon him. And besides, Sheng Xiang didn’t seem entirely useless.
But why did every clue they pursued seem to lead back to Sheng Xiang?
Could this seemingly frivolous nobleman be hiding a deeper secret? Was there an astonishing mystery behind his origins?
“Fragrance Dance”—The ultimate mastermind of the Nine Techniques Dance, Sheng Xiang, is about to tell his story.

104266.synopsis:
They always say that hard work pays off, but she doesn’t seem to think so.
Every effort always ends in failure. She doesn’t even have the protagonist’s halo like those in cheesy novels, even though she is the protagonist. Yu Linna wonders if this is God’s malice? Why is she always the target?! All she wants to say is:
“When will I finally be able to eat my fill?!”
—
The title Shion refers to the Tartarian aster(Aster tataricus flower)

106314.synopsis:
One day, Jeong-hwan starts having dreams where he becomes the male lead in a romance webtoon.
However, every time he has the dream, his condition worsens, making him worry that it might affect his exams. Since romance is far from his area of expertise, he turns to Song Hanbin for help who is also involved with him.
“I’ll teach you. If I show you how, you can do it, right?”
“Well, that depends on how good the teacher is.”
As Jeong-hwan continues practicing or rather, going on fake dates with Hanbin, his feelings grow more complicated.
“Hanbin seems totally fine… but I’m going crazy.”
Before Jeong-hwan’s exams are over, Hanbin must turn him into the perfect “main male lead” and raise his romance percentage to 100%!
Will Jeong-hwan and Hanbin be able to escape the world of a romance webtoon unscathed?

106570.synopsis:
Pei Qingjian transmigrated into a novel, becoming the delicate canary who had just signed an agreement but hadn’t officially started working yet for the short-lived CEO, Lin Xingchen.
Pei Qingjian: …What kind of decent person keeps a canary?
Pei Qingjian glanced down, and his eyes fell upon the clearly marked price of five million on the contract.
Pei Qingjian: Damn! No wonder this bigshot in front of me is so handsome! Anything you say, dear sugar daddy. No problem at all.
Therefore—
Lin Xingchen had a weak stomach, so Pei Qingjian personally cooked for him.
Lin Xingchen traveled frequently, and Pei Qingjian acted sweet and obedient.
Even when Lin Xingchen wanted to “explore the mysteries of life” with him, Pei Qingjian enthusiastically agreed and allowed him full reign.
Lin Xingchen’s friends and family were envious, sighing one after another: “He’s beautiful and treats you so well. Xingchen, you’re incredibly lucky!”
Lin Xingchen thought the same. He’s so thoughtful—he must really love me! If we ever separated, he’d surely be devastated!
Sure enough, one year later, as the contract came to an end,
Lin Xingchen noticed Pei Qingjian looking gloomy, hesitating to speak several times.
He loves me so much; surely he doesn’t want to leave but is too shy to say it. Such humble, heart-wrenching love! His little canary was truly endearing!
Isn’t it just because he can’t bear to part? Lin Xingchen decided to officially make his little canary his boyfriend!
“Do you have something to say to me?” Lin Xingchen asked gently. “Go ahead, I’ll agree to anything.”
Having earned his money, diligently working for a year, and excitedly planning his travels, Pei Qingjian: ???
Lin Xingchen: “I’ve noticed you’ve been upset these days.”
Pei Qingjian: Oh, about that… How can I tell you, my dear sugar daddy, your life is about to end soon?
Lin Xingchen: “Don’t feel pressured.”
Pei Qingjian: Alas, such a fine man. Why must he die young?
Lin Xingchen: “Feel free to tell me.”
Pei Qingjian: “The temple in the south of the city is said to be very effective. You might want to visit it when you have time.”
Lin Xingchen: ???
Later, Pei Qingjian was astonished to discover Lin Xingchen did not die at 26 as written in the novel.
Instead, he was cornered at the door and pressed against the wall by Lin Xingchen.
Pei Qingjian: ??? What’s this about? Recreating a classic CEO romance wall-press scene? That’s easy!
Pei Qingjian professionally wrapped his arms around Lin Xingchen’s neck and directly kissed him!
Lin Xingchen: !!!
Pei Qingjian: “After-sales service—first time free, but you’ll have to pay extra after the third time~”
Lin Xingchen: …
Lin Xingchen dragged him into the room, saying, “I’ll pay extra—I’ll pay for a lifetime.”
Pei Qingjian: ??? A lifetime? No need for that!
Afterwards,
Wrapped in a quilt, Pei Qingjian sat on the bed reflecting, “I thought we had a pure monetary relationship. You pay money, I provide the service, and we’re done when the deal ends.”
Lin Xingchen embraced his waist, whispering, “…Or maybe you could change the last few words.”
“Such as?”
“Paid dating.”
One-line introduction: Sweet, sweet, sweet.
Meaning: When giving roses to others, the fragrance lingers on your hand. Actively helping others will also bring you unexpected surprises and rewards.
associated_names: After Transmigrating, I Started a Paid Romance with the CEO

110666.synopsis:
After entering a tragic novel, Jiang Chi vows to rescue the protagonist shou.
This is a “marriage-for-luck” novel. The protagonist gong, Qin Yan, a wealthy and powerful man, marries the protagonist shou to bring good fortune after an accident leaves him in a coma. When Qin Yan wakes up, he is unwilling to let the protagonist shou go and forcibly keeps him, causing both emotional and physical torment.
Backstage at the wedding, Jiang Chi meets a handsome young man in a wedding suit.
The young man’s face is pale, cold, and aloof, but his eyes are full of emotion. When their eyes meet, Jiang Chi is instantly smitten.
Jiang Chi promptly picks up the frail young man and runs off with him.
That day, the Qin family urgently cancels the wedding because—
The family head, Qin Yan, has fled the wedding.
Jiang Chi hadn’t finished reading the original story, so he doesn’t know that the coma was a ruse or that he’s rescued the wrong person. Not only does he treat Qin Yan as the protagonist shou, but he also teaches him many dating skills to deal with the protagonist gong.
Qin Yan: This is very useful. I’ve learned a lot.
*
Qin Yan is cold by nature, raised in a world full of scheming and deception. He’s used to hiding his emotions and has never loved anyone, nor has anyone dared to love him.
Until one day, a gentle and handsome man comes into his life, saying he’ll protect him forever.
From disregarding him to falling deeply in love, Qin Yan loses all control.
He will never let Jiang Chi leave.
Even if Jiang Chi has mistaken him for someone else.
*
Later, when Jiang Chi learns the truth:
[Love Tip #03: When the other person is angry, avoid confronting them directly. It’s better to show weakness, such as acting cute or calling them ‘Husband.’] 
Qin Yan’s expression darkens, his eyes sharp: “Husband won’t stop loving me just because I’m gloomy, obsessive, and ruthless, right?”
Jiang Chi: “…Love? I love you way too much.”
———
#Silly Gong Who Thinks He’s Smart vs. Truly Smart and Powerful Shou#
[Marriage-for-Luck – “Chongxi” story (a trope in Chinese fiction where a sick or dying person is married in hopes the wedding will bring good luck and cure them)]

110922.synopsis:
Everyday Summer Vacation. And Before I Knew it, I Was the Strongest & Rich! 
A world where dungeons suddenly appeared everywhere. 
Even here in Japan was no exception. And in each prefecture, several large dungeons exist. 
In the dungeons, magic stones are found, an unknown energy source. And materials never seen before could be harvested. Those with talent all rushed to become [Explorers] and built up wealth. 
Meanwhile, the protagonist, Natsume Koichi, did not have any remarkable talent recognized even in the dungeon aptitude national test. And while still admiring explorers, he spent his days working as a corporate s*ave. 
Moreover, perhaps because of his clumsy personality bringing misfortune, he ended up getting fired from his company. 
At the bottom of despair, he returned to his family home. He then casually peeked into the secret base in the mountain that was his childhood playground. But there, a dungeon gate swaying and writhing had been born. 
Inside the dungeon gate, the summer vacation mountain spread out, where cries of cicadas poured down. Even though it was winter outside, the sense of seasons seemed bugged. 
According to an inspection by the authorities, the dungeon was certified as “just an empty space” with no monsters or items. But in truth, it was not like that――. 
Through self-training in the private dungeon, and repeatedly challenging the dungeons in the city areas, Natsume becomes famous and gains wealth.
associated_names: 凡人×現代ダンジョン×夏休みライフ＝成り上がり！？　〜こどもの頃の秘密基地跡にプライベートダンジョンができました〜

111434.synopsis:
I’m a Villain! Why Are You Trying to Date Me?
Lin Tian transmigrated into a cliché web novel world, becoming a low-level villain. Fortunately, he awakened the Survival System—as long as he lived long enough, he would receive generous rewards!
To avoid getting caught up in the protagonist and heroine’s drama, Lin Tian immediately decided to resign from his job under the beautiful CEO. However, to his horror, the CEO could hear his inner thoughts?!
Lin Tian: “President, I want to resign!”
Inner thoughts: If I don’t leave now, the protagonist will arrive soon, and I won’t even know how I died! Run, run! What a pity, though, this CEO is a real beauty!
Shang Chan: “No, you’re coming home with me tomorrow to meet my parents!”
…
Lin Tian: “Miss Bai, I really don’t know anything about you two!”
Inner thoughts: Jiang Yifeng, that s*umbag, is only trying to collect all the heroines into his harem to complete his Heavenly Saint Physique.
Bai Bing’er: “Lin Tian, from now on, you’ll work in my company—I’ll protect you!”
Lin Tian, who only wanted to stay far away from trouble, suddenly found himself at the center of all the chaos!
associated_names: 我是反派啊！你们找我谈什么恋爱？

113226.synopsis:
A boy named Atsumu was branded as “useless” by his famous sisters and banished from his entertainment-industry family. However, hidden within him was an extraordinarily talented “behind-the-scenes support” skill that neither he nor his family had noticed!
After transferring schools, Atsumu is now determined to live a normal life, but as he crosses paths with talented entertainers—VTubers, idols, and models—his natural ability starts to shine, making him their indispensable support. They can’t help but adore him, turning his simple wish for normality into a showbiz underdog success story!
associated_names: After being kicked out of the entertainment family I supported behind the scenes, I want to enjoy a normal youth. ~I'm bothered by idols, actors, and models who are pushing me for some reason, but I'm the only one who knows that the ice queen sitting next to me is a popular VTuber~
Urakata de Support Shiteta Geinou Ikka wo Tsuihousareta Boku wa, Futsuu no Seishun wo Ouka Shitai
裏方でサポートしてた芸能一家を追放された僕は、普通の青春を謳歌したい。〜なぜかアイドルや俳優、モデルが推しかけてきて困ってるのに、隣の席の氷の女王が人気Vtuberなのを僕だけが知ってる件について〜

114506.synopsis:
One day, an ordinary office worker, Park Geonwoo, suddenly receives a message:
[You did not meet the conditions] 
[Resetting the day] 
If he fails the mission, the day resets?!
In other words, he can never reach tomorrow?
Trapped in an endless loop of today, today, and today again!
To finally reach ‘tomorrow,’ this man must find a way to end ‘today.’
The fierce struggle of Park Geonwoo begins now!

116554.synopsis:
Shen Anning, a university student plagued by two decades of bad luck, finally caught a lucky break—
Only to die the day before her fortune arrived.
Maybe her resentment was just too intense, because right before death, she got bound to a wish-fulfillment system, kicking off her journey across multiple worlds.
But after meticulously selecting her, the poor system regrets it every day:
Why is my host always so unpredictable?!
Cannon fodder palace maid in the Qing court
Palace intrigue? No thanks. She clutches the son of a guaranteed-to-rise prince and snacks on drama with her besties.
Neglected stepdaughter facing emotional ab*se in the 1970s
Sent down to the countryside? Nope—she sends her s*umbag dad packing instead.
Cannon fodder peasant girl in ancient times
The suffering wife of a poor scholar? Anyone who wants him can have him!
Ex-girlfriend in a dog-blood CEO romance
Love-brained fool? Not her. Even dogs wouldn’t eat that trope.
Cannon fodder ranked ninth in the imperial court
(Details not expanded in synopsis)
Little maid from Dream of the Red Chamber
(Red Chamber-inspired arc)
Village girl cannon fodder in the 1960s
(Typical retro countryside setting)
The “legitimate eldest son” cannon fodder in ancient times
(FL presumably gender-bent or disguised)
Top-tier human furnace in a cultivation story
Used and discarded? Not happening.
Mother of a luckless “Child of Destiny” in a xianxia world
Save the world? Nah—she’d rather ascend and leave it all behind.
